Would either of you be available for a 30-minute conversation during any of these windows (PDT):
- Tue Apr 5: 9:30–11:30am or 3:00–5:00pm
- Wed Apr 6: 10:00–12:00pm
- Thu Apr 7: 8:30–11:00am

Subject: Amy Zhou — reference call summary (Daniel Park, Fintegrate)

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Quick capture from the 10:00am conversation with Daniel Park (Fintegrate) about Amy Zhou. Call was 26 minutes. Attaching the filled questionnaire and my short notes.

Summary: Strong recommend
- Overall: Daniel rated Amy a 4/5 for technical execution and a 5/5 for ownership. He emphasized her ability to stabilize services under load and lead incident responses.
- Example: Amy led a post-mortem on a cascading cache miss problem that reduced P99 by ~30% after changes she championed; Daniel said she "owned the follow-through" and worked well with SREs.
- Collaboration/communication: Comfortable explaining tradeoffs to PMs and non-engineers; Daniel noted she could be direct but fair in disagreements.
- Growth areas: Prefers deep focus over broad context-switching; may need clear scope when stepping into cross-functional leadership.
- Any concerns: None immediate; Daniel explicitly said he would hire her again.

Attachments / artifacts:
- [Attachment: amy_zhou_ref_notes.docx] (summary + questionnaire)
- Call audio/notes saved to Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aB-example-amy-call-audio

Action items:
- Laura: consider a short technical follow-up to probe cross-team leadership scope during onsites (10–15 min).
- Marissa: I will add the reference summary to the candidate record in HubSpot (HubSpot-Contact-HS-12345).

If you want me to reach out to Sofia Ruiz for a second reference before finalizing, say so — I have her availability as well.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
